text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dang it... another loss. I need to sort out
my
weaknesses immediately.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go over my positioning, path
selection, and
the timing of my final
spurt to figure out what I
can do better
on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go over my positioning, path
selection, and
the timing of my final
spurt to figure out what I
can do better
on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll bounce back! Just you wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And after I've taken the world for
myself, when
the interviewers approach
me for a few words to
the audience...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell them that my consecutive defeats
were
what built the foundation for my
success!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whatever it takes, I'll claw my way out
of this
slump.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as a dream that
can't be
achieved, and I'll prove it!
